latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of changelog-generator-pro.
- Automatically generates user-facing changelogs from git commit history.
- Categorizes commits (features, improvements, bug fixes, breaking changes, security).
- Translates technical commit messages into clear, customer-friendly language.
- Formats release notes professionally and filters out internal noise like refactoring or test commits.
- Supports custom guidelines and focused changelog generation by date or version.
